checks.name: First-level pools contain ten unique cards per tier
checks.detail: 20 first-level definitions; barracks cards are reserved for later levels.

checks.name: Opening offers are unique silver choices with a generic option
checks.detail: Validated 32 opening selections; no mixed tier or prismatic offer.

checks.name: Opening waits before spawning or advancing combat
checks.detail: Choice overlay owns a completely idle battle.

checks.name: Opening gates building, spells, pause and speed
checks.detail: Affordability is supplied deliberately; the choice gate rejects the actions.

checks.name: Invalid choice indices cannot start combat
checks.detail: The selection remains pending after invalid input.

checks.name: One valid opening choice starts combat once
checks.detail: An extra click cannot grant a second opening card.

checks.name: Stored Mana grants twelve mana only once
checks.detail: Duplicate activation cannot repeat an immediate grant.

checks.name: Construction grant discounts exactly three future builds
checks.detail: The fourth build pays full cost; discounts do not refund prior purchases.

checks.name: Long Range applies to existing and future towers without mutating prefabs
checks.detail: Runtime effective range receives +0.5m; shared serialized range stays unchanged.

checks.name: Frost duration and ordinary Blast radius use their separate modifiers
checks.detail: The Blast calibration does not increase shatter radius.

checks.name: Repeated Frost refreshes the augmented duration without stacking slow
checks.detail: Two hits retain the same movement multiplier and refresh to 3.25 seconds.

checks.name: Shield absorbs leaks before core health and leaks give no rewards
checks.detail: Leak damage is spent once against shield, then health.

checks.name: Mana Scavenger triggers on the eighth kill
checks.detail: The extra mana is added to each profile's ordinary mana drop.

checks.name: Lucky Loot modifies only one base gold reward per kill
checks.detail: 100 seeded kill resolutions: each reward is base or base+50%; mana is unchanged; bonus drops=17

checks.name: Combined Arms grants its reward when the third type is built
checks.detail: Exactly 30 gold and 6 mana after the full roster exists.

checks.name: Combined Arms cannot repeat on another build
checks.detail: The roster reward is run-local and one-shot.

checks.name: Focused Flame rewards precise inner-half placement
checks.detail: Inner, outer and outside targets receive the expected distinct damage.

checks.name: Heavy Hunter boosts tower damage before heavy armor
checks.detail: +30% tower damage still passes through the profile's reduction.

checks.name: Heavy Hunter does not boost ordinary targets
checks.detail: The conditional modifier is limited to Heavy profiles.

checks.name: Gun Rhythm adds one 60% bullet after three ordinary shots
checks.detail: The echo does not advance or recursively trigger the ordinary-shot counter.

checks.name: Rhythm counter resets when a tower is disabled
checks.detail: A recycled or restarted actor cannot inherit a pending echo.

checks.name: Frost Mark boosts Gun attacks against slowed targets
checks.detail: Gun damage receives +30% without consuming Frost.

checks.name: Frost Mark does not boost Frost's own damage
checks.detail: The vulnerability belongs specifically to Gun attacks.

checks.name: Shatter Resonance boosts only the one shatter explosion
checks.detail: Normal Blast damage is unchanged; the direct target consumes Frost once.

checks.name: Falling Fireball is excluded from Burning Mark queries
checks.detail: The falling visual does not create a burn vulnerability.

checks.name: Burning point containment is planar and bounded
checks.detail: Vertical position does not change the circular XZ coverage.

checks.name: Extended Burn deals eight ticks and returns to its pool
checks.detail: Four seconds preserve the configured half-second tick interval.

checks.name: Fire Dividend pays only a successful paid cast
checks.detail: An invalid location grants neither gold nor a spell and does not spend mana.

checks.name: Field Workshop discounts future upgrades without retrospective refunds
checks.detail: Both upgrade stages use ceiling-rounded gold fees; mana is unchanged.

checks.name: Two upgrades remain the cap with Workshop
checks.detail: The discount never introduces a fourth tower level or extra payment.

checks.name: Type Specialization stays inactive below three towers
checks.detail: Two towers do not satisfy the threshold.

checks.name: Type Specialization boosts the qualifying type at three towers
checks.detail: Three Gun towers unlock +25% Gun damage.

checks.name: Type Specialization does not boost other tower types
checks.detail: An unqualified Frost tower retains ordinary damage.

checks.name: Burning Mark boosts tower hits inside an active burn
checks.detail: The Fireball's current coverage changes tower damage.

checks.name: Overlapping burns do not stack Burning Mark
checks.detail: Two active areas still apply a single +25% vulnerability.

checks.name: Leaving the burn immediately removes Burning Mark
checks.detail: The modifier is spatial, not a persistent enemy debuff.

checks.name: Field Medic heals on kill milestones up to six times
checks.detail: 100 kills include six completed 15-kill milestones; no seventh payment.

checks.name: Field Medic cannot exceed the core's configured maximum
checks.detail: Healing at full health does not create excess health or shield.

checks.detail: The second choice occurs before the fourth assault phase.

checks.name: Second choice restores the previous double speed
checks.detail: Choosing a card does not silently reset the player's 2x setting.
